regions.quote: The variable stream catfish, Akysis varius, is a small akysid catfish from the Mekong drainage in Laos, Thailand and Cambodia.

regions.name: Xe Bangfai
regions.quote: Described from the Xe Bangfai river system with type locality around 3 km upstream of Ban Pakphanang village in Khammouane/Khammouan province, central western Laos.

regions.name: Mun River
regions.quote: It's also known from the Mun River basin in Ubon Ratchathani and Nakhon Ratchasima provinces, central eastern Thailand as well as the Siem Reap river, which flows through the province of the same name, in northwestern Cambodia.
